resolution_criteria: Which party controls the US Senate after the 2026 elections, including any runoffs: Democrats if they and the independents who caucus with them hold at least 51 seats, or 50 with a Democratic vice-presidential tiebreak; otherwise Republicans. A YES answer means Democrats. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when control is called.
